# Third-party

Vendored files used by this repository. Each directory has its own README
with the source, version, license and update notes.

| Directory | What | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| [utest/](utest/) | single-header C/C++ test framework | [sheredom/utest.h](https://github.com/sheredom/utest.h) | Unlicense (public domain) |
| [htmx/](htmx/) | HTMX for the example frontend | [htmx.org](https://htmx.org) v2.0.4 | BSD 2-Clause |
| [jsmn/](jsmn/) | header-only JSON tokenizer | [zserge/jsmn](https://github.com/zserge/jsmn) v1.1.0 | MIT |

Never edit vendored files - update them wholesale per the per-directory
notes.
